options.text: A high-octane white-water rafting adventure on the Breede River.

anti_commodity_copy_rewrite.ota_headline: De Kloof Luxury Estate: Historic Cape Dutch Charm with Serene Gardens & Wellness Spa in Swellendam
anti_commodity_copy_rewrite.property_overview_150_words: Nestled in the historic heart of Swellendam, De Kloof Luxury Estate offers a refined escape within a beautifully preserved Cape Dutch manor. Experience discreet luxury across elegant rooms and suites, each designed for ultimate comfort and tranquility. Meander through lush, award-winning gardens, indulge in rejuvenating treatments at the on-site wellness spa, or savor exquisite cuisine on the scenic outdoor terrace. With attentive service and a serene atmosphere, De Kloof provides a perfect base for exploring Swellendam's rich heritage, picturesque landscapes, and local culinary delights, ensuring an unforgettable stay in the Western Cape.
